app_type: Real-time Monitoring & Control Room Analytics Dashboard

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all major panel titles and the main dashboard header.

body_data.usage: CRITICAL: Use monospace for ALL live telemetry streams, scores, model weights, and coordinate data to ensure numbers don't jump horizontally during 2Hz WebSocket updates. Use tabular-nums.

colors.rule: Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Use stark structural grayscale for hierarchy, and reserve the semantic colors strictly for charting, status modes, and telemetry highlights.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders strategy: Use 1px sharp borders (`border-border`) with flat white backgrounds for widgets. Avoid soft drop shadows; instead, use strict, technical grid boundaries. Apply a very subtle `-translate-y-px shadow-sm` on hover for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.anomaly_panel: Use 'The Tracing Beam' (Linear/Aceternity style) or an explicit red/warning colored left-border (`border-l-4 border-l-red-500`) to highlight the LLM Anomaly/Insight panel, making it distinct from normal telemetry.
visual_enhancers.radar_field: Use an explicit canvas or SVG backdrop with concentric circles colored in muted gray (`stroke-zinc-200`) and overlay glowing, animated elements (`bg-blue-500/20`, etc.) to simulate the unfolding frequencies.

layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (Bento Layout). Every pixel matters for control rooms.
layouts.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6

sections.header: col-span-full h-16 sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-between px-6
sections.virtual_field_radar: col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 row-span-2 bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-6 flex flex-col (Virtual Scannable Field)
sections.bubbles_core_fusion: col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 row-span-1 bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-6 (Fusion & Confidence Engine)
sections.model_weights: col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 row-span-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 (Presence, Motion, Signal, Stability)
sections.llm_insights: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6
sections.telemetry_stream: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 (Live WebSockets, RSSI, CSI)

motion.websocket_interpolation: Use framer-motion `spring` physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20) for the Bubbles Core and Model Score gauges so the 2Hz updates feel fluid rather than jumping abruptly.
motion.radar_waves: Use infinite CSS keyframe animations or framer-motion looping variants to slowly expand concentric rings (`scale: [1, 2, 3], opacity: [0.8, 0, 0]`) simulating electromagnetic waves.

components.BubblesCore: A central visualization (SVG or HTML nodes). Render floating `motion.div` circles that map to object/presence. Size = object volume/distance, Color = confidence scale (e.g., violet for high confidence, gray for low).
components.VirtualScannableField: A radar/spatial map overlay showing 5G/LTE/3G/UMTS coverage areas. It should look technical and map-like. Plot coordinates [x,y] of detected entities on this spatial canvas.
components.ConfidenceGauge: Use a semi-circle or radial progress gauge (via Recharts or pure SVG) mapped to the FusionEngine combined score.
components.ModelScorePanels: 4 distinct micro-cards. Each displays its fixed weight (0.40, 0.30, 0.20, 0.10) alongside the live score. Use `tabular-nums` heavily.
components.ConfigModeSwitcher: A segmented control (Shadcn Tabs customized to look like a hardware toggle switch) to change modes: Normal, Active, Idle, Anomaly.
components.CSI_Charts: Use Recharts (`AreaChart` or `LineChart`) with dot=false, strokeWidth=1, and linear gradients that fade into the bottom. Minimal grid lines.
components.SystemDiagram: For `system-diagram.html` or the React equivalent page, use an architectural node-based flow. e.g., 'Raw Data -> Models -> Fusion -> Dashboard'.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA contrast, especially inside the Bubbles Core (ensure text inside bubbles is readable).
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` attributes to every gauge, chart container, websocket status indicator, mode switcher, and telemetry row (e.g., `data-testid="mode-switch-active"`, `data-testid="fusion-score-value"`).

3d_libraries.radar_canvas: visx or standard HTML5 Canvas/SVG (for the spatial scannable field). Keep it 2D flat for maximum precision in the light theme, unless WebGL is strictly necessary for high node counts.

abstract_wave_backgrounds.description: Abstract white mesh wave. Can be used for the system diagram page background at 10% opacity.

component_instructions.file_extension: CRITICAL: Generate all components as `.jsx` or `.js` files, not `.tsx`. Ensure standard React JS patterns.
component_instructions.ui_library: Use Shadcn/UI for structured elements (Tabs for config mode, Cards, Dialogs) but strip away Vercel-like dropshadows to fit the Swiss Technical Grid.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not make generic centered layouts. The dashboard must be left-aligned, highly dense, and grid-based.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖, 🔮, 🧠. Use professional `lucide-react` icons (e.g., Activity, Radio, Scan).
Ensure the WebSocket connection status (connected/reconnecting/error) is perpetually visible in the header with a pulsing indicator.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding) within parent containers, but keep the data streams tight and dense.
Do not add universal transitions (`transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease`.
